info.description: Pastoral Reports backend API: JWT cookie auth and RBAC
info.title: Pastoral Reports API

post.description: Admin only. One sheet per report of the month (at most 100), in the legacy layout (D-A6). Writes a DOWNLOAD_BULK_EXCEL audit row.
post.summary: Download a month of reports as Excel

post.description: Admin only. Builds the workbook the export would build, for one report (report_id) or one month (month and year), and returns each sheet's name and A1:G42 cell text. Writes no audit row (D-A15).
Admin only. Returns the report in the legacy Church Growth Program Report layout (D-A6) and writes a DOWNLOAD_SINGLE_EXCEL audit row.

post.summary: Assign a permission to a role

delete.summary: Revoke a permission from a role

get.description: Counts for one month: reports (total, approved, pending) and, regardless of month, all users and admins. Admin role only. Without month and year the period is the previous month in Asia/Manila. Month and year go together; the month is an English month name, case-insensitive.

post.description: Admin only. Creates an account with an optional role (default: user) and the profile text that prefills the report form. This is the only way to create an account. confirm_password is required and must equal password exactly (422 on confirm_password).

put.description: Admin only. Replaces the name and the area and church text. The password and role are not changed here.
put.summary: Update a user's name and profile

delete.description: Admin only. Marks the account deleted with an optional reason (at most 500 characters, trimmed). A deleted user cannot sign in, gets the same answer as an unknown email, and all of their sessions end. Their email stays reserved and their status does not change. You cannot delete your own account, and the only active admin cannot be deleted. An already-deleted user answers 200 and changes and audits nothing. The body may be empty.

post.description: Admin only. Sets a new password for another user (they never see the old one, and nobody can read it back). It ends all of the user's sessions, clears their login lockout and is audited as ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD. The new password follows the change-password rules: strong enough (422 on new_password), at most 72 bytes, and confirm_password must equal it exactly (422 on confirm_password). You cannot reset your own password (403): use change-password. Any status and any role may be reset; the status does not change.

Admin only. Clears the deleted mark, so the user can sign in again if their status is active; the status does not change. The audit row keeps who deleted them, when and why. A user who is not deleted answers 200 and changes and audits nothing.

put.description: Admin only. Sets the status to active, inactive, disciplinary or deceased. Only an active account can sign in; moving a user away from active ends all of their sessions. You cannot change your own status, and the only active admin cannot be moved away from active. The same status as now answers 200 and changes and audits nothing.

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password. The current password is checked against the same failure counter as login (5 wrong attempts lock the account for 15 minutes). The user's other sign-ins end; this one stays and its access token is renewed. A wrong current password is a 422 on current_password, not a 401, so the client does not read it as a lost session. confirm_password is required and must equal new_password exactly (422 on confirm_password); that check runs first, so a typo does not count as a failed attempt.

get.description: Returns the CSRF token for the current client. The same value is set in the HttpOnly csrf_token cookie; send it back in the X-CSRF-Token header on POST/PUT/DELETE requests.

post.description: Sends a password reset token to the email if it exists
Authenticates the user and sets the access_token and refresh_token cookies (HttpOnly)
Ends the sign-in the refresh_token cookie belongs to and clears both cookies. It needs no valid access token, so it works after that has expired.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's ID, name, email, role and permissions, read live from the database. Use it to show or hide actions; the server still enforces every permission.

post.description: Trades the refresh_token cookie for a new access token and a new refresh token, both set as cookies. The old refresh token stops working. Answers 401 and clears the cookies when the refresh token is unknown, expired, idle too long, revoked, or its account may no longer sign in. A token that was rotated within the last 10 seconds (a second tab) is a 401 that leaves the cookies alone.

Resets the user's password using a valid reset token. The new password follows the same rules as change-password: strong enough (422 on new_password) and at most 72 bytes. confirm_password is required and must equal new_password exactly (422 on confirm_password), checked before the token.

get.description: Returns OK if the service is running
Returns OK if the process is alive
Returns OK if the DB is connected
Returns a page of reports, newest first. Without reports:read_any the list is limited to the caller's own reports.

parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on area assignment
parameters.name: area

parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on church name
parameters.name: church

post.description: Files a monthly report for the current user. A missing year defaults to the current year.

get.description: Returns one report. Without reports:read_any only the caller's own report is visible; another user's report is 404.

put.description: Replaces the report's fields and its whole metric set. A missing year keeps the current year. Without reports:write_any only the caller's own report can be updated.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a report. Without reports:delete_any only the caller's own report can be deleted.

patch.description: Flips the report's completed flag. Requires reports:approve, which works on any report by ID. Returns metadata only, never report text.

get.description: Admin only. Returns paginated list of users

parameters.description: Filter by status; all or empty means every status. deleted returns only deleted users; every other value leaves them out
parameters.name: status

get.description: Admin only. Returns a single user

confirm_password.description:
ConfirmPassword must equal NewPassword exactly. It is checked before any service
call, so a typo never counts as a failed current-password attempt.
ConfirmPassword must equal Password exactly; it is checked and dropped, never stored.

area_assignment.description: Report form defaults; empty when the admin has not set them.

confirm_password.description: ConfirmPassword must equal NewPassword exactly; checked before the token is looked up.
